 PROCEDURE MISCE_PREBATCH;                                              25490001          
 BEGIN                                                                  25500001          
   INTEGER I_EVENTO,I_IND_EVENTO,I_IND_RCHZOS,I_IND;                    25510001          
   BOOLEAN B_PREBATCH_ALL_COP;                                          25510101          
                                                                        25520001          
   DF_DISPLAY("E>050110<",                                              25520100          
              "INICIA MISCE_PREBATCH EN S500L010PREBATCH");             25520200          
   FOR I_IND_RCHZOS := 0 STEP 1 UNTIL 12 DO BEGIN                       25530001          
     DA_NUM_RCHZOS[I_IND_RCHZOS] := 0;                                  25540001          
     DA_IMP_RCHZOS[I_IND_RCHZOS] := 0;                                  25550001          
   END;                                                                 25560001          
   B_DIALOGO_FOR:= FALSE;                                               25570001          
   IF EA_MY_HOST = "VDMKAPPA"  OR                                       25580001          
      EA_MY_HOST = "ACYPBETA" OR EA_MY_HOST = "CACYPBET" OR             25600001          
      EA_MY_HOST = "ACYPOMEGA" THEN                                     25610001          
   ELSE                                                                 25620001          
      WAIT((180));                                                      25630001          
   B_PREBATCH:= TRUE;                                                   25640001          
   B_PREBATCH_OK:= FALSE;                                               25650001          
   RESET(E_ESPERA_PREBATCH);                                            25660001          
   B_TERMINO_CARGACAT:= FALSE;                                          25660100          
   FOR I_IND:=0 STEP 1 UNTIL DF_NUMCOPIAS_P010 - 1 DO                   25660200          
       BA_COP_CARGACAT[I_IND]:= FALSE;                                  25660300          
   DF_MIXES_RSPO("HI 1030");                                            25670001          
   DF_MIXES_RSPO_P016("HI 1030");                                       25670051          
   IF B_DISPLAYS THEN BEGIN                                             25670101          
      DF_DISP("<L010> PREBATCH --- ENTRO CICLO DE ESPERA PREBATCH,  "); 25670201          
      DF_DISP("<L010> PREBATCH --- 5 MINUTOS O TODAS LAS COPIAS EN  "); 25670301          
      DF_DISP("<L010> PREBATCH --- ESPERA DE PREBATCH               "); 25670401          
   END;                                                                 25670501          
   DO                                                                   25680001          
   BEGIN                                                                25690001          
     I_EVENTO:= WAITANDRESET((60),E_PREBATCH,E_RECUP);                  25700001          
     IF I_EVENTO = 3 THEN                                               25700101          
     BEGIN                                                              25700201          
       RESULT:= 51;                                                     25700301          
       DF_DISPLAY("E>050110<","FALLA EN PREBATCH SE HACE                25700401          
       RECUPERACION "CAT STRING(RESULT,*));                             25700501          
     END;                                                               25700601          
     IF I_EVENTO = 1 THEN                                               25710001          
     BEGIN                                                              25720001          
       I_IND_EVENTO:= * + 1;                                            25730001          
       IF I_IND_EVENTO = 5 THEN                                         25740001          
          RESULT:= 17;                                                  25750001          
     END;                                                               25760001          
     B_PREBATCH_ALL_COP:=TRUE;                                          25760101          
     FOR I_IND:=0 STEP 1 UNTIL DF_NUMCOPIAS_P010 - 1 DO                 25760201          
         IF NOT BA_COP_PREBATCH[I_IND] THEN BEGIN                       25760301          
            B_PREBATCH_ALL_COP:=FALSE;                                  25760401          
            I_IND:= DF_NUMCOPIAS_P010;                                  25760501          
         END;                                                           25760601          
   END                                                                  25770001          
   UNTIL B_PREBATCH_ALL_COP OR                                          25780001          
         RESULT > 0;                                                    25830001          
   DF_DISP("<L010> ENTRO AL LLAMADO S127 CENTRALIZADO");                25830021          
   HAGO_LLAMADO_S127;                                                   25830041          
   DF_DISP("<L010> SALGO AL LLAMADO S127 CENTRALIZADO");                25830061          
   IF B_DISPLAYS THEN                                                   25830101

       BA_COP_PREBATCH[I_IND]:= FALSE;                                  25850001          
   DF_DISPLAY("E>050110<",                                              25850100          
              "TERMINA MISCE_PREBATCH EN S500L010PREBATCH");            25850200          
 END;                                                                   25860001

 BEGIN                                                                  34156201

%*********************************************************************  40983410          
 PROCEDURE S500L010CTR_TIME_FM(AREACOMUN);                              40983412          
 EBCDIC ARRAY AREACOMUN[0];                                             40983414          
%*********************************************************************  40983416          
 BEGIN                                                                  40983418          
  DOUBLE D_CT_TRN_TIME;                                                 40983420

%% TIEMPO DE TRANSACCION  FM                                            40983424          
  IF I_DF_I_CT_FIN_TIME < I_DF_I_CT_INI_TIME THEN                       40983426          
%% 86400000000 = MICROSEGUNDOS DE 24 HORAS.                             40983428          
     D_CT_TRN_TIME := (I_DF_I_CT_FIN_TIME + 86400000000) -              40983430          
                       I_DF_I_CT_INI_TIME                               40983432          
  ELSE                                                                  40983434          
     D_CT_TRN_TIME :=  I_DF_I_CT_FIN_TIME - I_DF_I_CT_INI_TIME;         40983436

 INTEGER PROCEDURE S500L010SINCRHI163;                                  43702706          
%--------------------------------------------------------------         43702806          
  BEGIN                                                                 43702906          
   INTEGER RESULT, I_IND;                                               43703006          
   ARRAY REFERENCE A_L010[0];                                           43703106          
   DIRECT ARRAY A_LOG [0:DF_SIZELOG - 1];                               43703206

          ,I_TCAMVTA;                                                   43703706          
%INI ECC CONTROL DYR FII                                                43703707

   IF I_DF_LOG_CONT_DYR = 1 THEN BEGIN                                  43703710

  ARRAY NOMBRE_PRG, MIX_SPO[0:5];                                       43707306          
  ARRAY SCR1,SCR2[0:200];                                               43707406          
  STRING MEZCLA;                                                        43707506          
                                                                        43707606          
  I_HI_PASO  := IDF_I_HI_PASO ;                                         43707706          
  I_HI_MIX   := IDF_I_HI_MIX  ;                                         43707806          
                                                                        43707906          
  REPLACE POINTER(NOMBRE_PRG) BY "(S500)S500/OBJECT/P008";              43708006          
  REPLACE POINTER(SCR1) BY 48"00" FOR (SIZE(SCR1)*2);                   43708106          
  GETMIXNO(NOMBRE_PRG,MIX_SPO);                                         43708206          
  MEZCLA:= STRING(MIX_SPO[0],4);                                        43708306          
                                                                        43708406          
  IF MIX_SPO[0]  > 0 THEN                                               43708506          
     BEGIN                                                              43708606          
       REPLACE POINTER(SCR1) BY MEZCLA, " HI 84";                       43708706          
       DCKEYIN(POINTER(SCR1),SCR2);                                     43708806          
     END                                                                43708906          
  ELSE                                                                  43709006          
     S500L010HINOTLOCKED:=1;                                            43709106          
                                                                        43709206          
  END;                                                                  43709306          
%FIN  PRB NOTLOCKED                                                     43709406          
 INTEGER PROCEDURE S500L010BAJAESCALON;                                 43709408          
 BEGIN                                                                  43709410          
     EBCDIC ARRAY EA_RSPO[0:49];                                        43709412          
     ARRAY NOMBRE_PRG, MIX_SPO[0:5], SCR1,SCR2[0:200];                  43709414          
     POINTER P_EA_RSPO, P_MIX_P008;                                     43709416          
     STRING MEZCLA;                                                     43709426          
     INTEGER  I_DF_IND1                                                 43709428          
             ,I_EVEN_BAJA                                               43709430          
             ,RESULT                                                    43709432          
             ,I_VAL_CAUSE;                                              43709433          
     DF_DISPLAY("E>050110<",                                            43709434          
                "INICIA BAJA_ESCALONADA EN S500L010BAJAESCALON");       43709436          
     I_VAL_BAJA :=1;                                                    43709438          
     I_MY_COPIA:=0;                                                     43709440          
     DF_DISP("<L010> ENTRO A CICLO HI X COPIA");                        43709442          
     FOR I_DF_IND1:= 0 STEP 1 UNTIL DF_NUMCOPIAS_P010 - 1 DO            43709444          
     BEGIN                                                              43709446          
      REPLACE EA_RSPO BY " " FOR SIZE(EA_RSPO);                         43709447          
      P_EA_RSPO:= EA_RSPO;                                              43709448          
      RESET (E_BAJA_ESCALONADA);                                        43709449          
      RESET (E_ESPERA_P008);                                            43709450          
      I_EVEN_BAJA:= 0 ;                                                 43709451          
      I_MY_COPIA : = * + 1;                                             43709452          
      IF MIXES[I_DF_IND1] > 0  THEN                                     43709453          
         REPLACE P_EA_RSPO:P_EA_RSPO BY                                 43709454          
         MIXES[I_DF_IND1] FOR 4 DIGITS                                  43709455          
         ," "                                                           43709456          
         ;                                                              43709458          
      IF OFFSET(P_EA_RSPO) > 0 THEN                                     43709460          
         REPLACE P_EA_RSPO:P_EA_RSPO BY "HI 1006";                      43709462          
                                                                        43709470          
      I_MIX_P008:= I_DF_IND1 ;                                          43709472          
      I_TIEMPO :=0;                                                     43709476          
     IF EXISTE_BAJA [I_DF_IND1] THEN                                    43709477          
       DF_DISP("<L010> VERIFICAR COPIA : " !! STRING(I_MY_COPIA,*)      43709479          
       !!  " MIX : " !! STRING (MIXES[I_DF_IND1],4) !!                  43709480          
       " YA FUE DADA DE BAJA ")                                         43709481          
     ELSE                                                               43709484          
      BEGIN                                                             43709485          
          DF_DISP("<L010> HI 1006 COPIA : " !! STRING(I_MY_COPIA,*)     43709486          
          !! " MIX : " !! STRING (MIXES[I_DF_IND1],4) );                43709487          
          RSPO(EA_RSPO);                                                43709488          
          DO                                                            43709490          
          BEGIN                                                         43709492          
           I_EVEN_BAJA:= WAIT ((120),E_BAJA_ESCALONADA,E_BAJA_REC);     43709494          
           IF I_EVEN_BAJA = 1 THEN BEGIN                                43709506          
              DF_DISP("<L010> PROBLEMAS CON COPIA : " !! STRING         43709508          
              (I_MY_COPIA,*) !! " MIX : " !! STRING                     43709510          
              (MIXES[I_DF_IND1],4));                                    43709512          
              RESET (E_ESPERA_P008);                                    43709514          
              REPLACE POINTER(NOMBRE_PRG) BY "(S500)S500/OBJECT/P008";  43709516          
              REPLACE POINTER(SCR1) BY 48"00" FOR (SIZE(SCR1)*2);       43709518          
              GETMIXNO(NOMBRE_PRG,MIX_SPO);                             43709520          
              MEZCLA:= STRING(MIX_SPO[0],4);                            43709522          
              I_TIEMPO := * + 120;                                      43709524          
              IF MIX_SPO[0]  > 0 THEN BEGIN                             43709526          
                 REPLACE POINTER(SCR1) BY MEZCLA, " HI 85";             43709528          
                 DCKEYIN(POINTER(SCR1),SCR2);                           43709530          
               END;                                                     43709532          
              WAIT (E_ESPERA_P008);                                     43709534          
            END; %% FIN DEL IF I_EVEN_BAJA = 1                          43709536          
           IF I_EVEN_BAJA = 3 THEN BEGIN                                43709538          
              DF_DISP("<L010> HAY RECUPERACION CHECAR COPIAS ");        43709540          
              RESULT:=1;                                                43709542          
              I_DF_IND1 := 15;                                          43709544          
            END; %% FIN DEL IF I_EVEN_BAJA = 3                          43709546          
          END                                                           43709548          
          UNTIL I_EVEN_BAJA = 2  OR                                     43709550          
                I_EVEN_BAJA = 3;                                        43709552          
     END; %% END DEL ELSE PARA DAR HI´S                                 43709554          
    END; %% END DEL FOR                                                 43709556          
    IF (I_DF_IND1 = DF_NUMCOPIAS_P010 - 1 OR                            43709558          
        I_DF_IND1 > DF_NUMCOPIAS_P010 - 1) AND                          43709559          
       (I_EVEN_BAJA = 2 OR I_EVEN_BAJA = 3) THEN BEGIN                  43709560          
       FOR I_DF_IND1:= 0 STEP 1 UNTIL DF_NUMCOPIAS_P010 - 1 DO          43709562          
           EXISTE_BAJA [I_DF_IND1]:= FALSE;                             43709564          
       I_VAL_BAJA :=0;                                                  43709566          
     END;                                                               43709568          
 DF_DISPLAY("E>050110<",                                                43709570          
           "TERMINA BAJA_ESCALONADA EN S500L010BAJAESCALON");           43709572          
 S500L010BAJAESCALON:= RESULT;                                          43709574          
 END;                                                                   43709576

 INTEGER PROCEDURE S500L010CONFBAJA(AREACOMUN);                         43709580          
 EBCDIC ARRAY AREACOMUN[0];                                             43709582          
 BEGIN                                                                  43709584          
 INTEGER I_BAJA_PASO                                                    43709586          
        ,I_BAJA_COPIA                                                   43709588          
        ;                                                               43709590          
  I_BAJA_PASO  := IDF_I_BAJAPASO;                                       43709592          
  I_BAJA_COPIA := IDF_I_COPIA;                                          43709594          
  IF IDF_I_BAJAPASO = 10 OR                                             43709596          
     IDF_I_BAJAPASO = 16    THEN BEGIN                                  43709598          
     EXISTE_BAJA [IDF_I_COPIA - 1] := TRUE;                             43709602          
     IF IDF_I_COPIA = I_MY_COPIA THEN BEGIN                             43709606          
        CAUSE (E_BAJA_ESCALONADA);                                      43709626          
        DF_DISP("CONTINUA SIGUIENTE COPIA");                            43709628          
     END;                                                               43709630          
   END;                                                                 43709636          
  END;                                                                  43709646
